_comment: Hand-maintained publication list. This file is the source of truth. scripts/update_publications.py merges newly discovered DOIs from Crossref into publications.json, but never overwrites what is here. Add anything Crossref cannot see (abstracts, Arcadia pubs without indexed metadata) directly to `entries`. Put DOIs you never want listed into `exclude`.
